function.arguments: {"observation": "The cross-tabulation of arm vs severity shows a strong imbalance: treatment arm has 32 mild, 40 moderate, 27 severe; control arm has 78 mild, 35 moderate, 10 severe. Sicker patients (severe) are under-represented in the treatment arm, while milder patients are over-represented.", "implication": "The raw difference in response rates is confounded by baseline severity. Since clinicians preferred to assign treatment to less severe (milder) patients, and milder patients have higher response rates regardless of treatment, the observed lower response in treatment is not necessarily due to the drug being ineffective — it may be due to the treatment group being systematically healthier. Therefore, a raw difference in proportions between arms is not a valid estimate of the treatment effect. We must adjust for severity (e.g., stratify or model it) to isolate the true treatment effect."}
function.name: note_finding
